contract.purpose: RolePatch helps job seekers prepare a resume for a specific role by connecting the job requirements to supplied experience and showing a reviewable patch.
contract.purposeSource: DESIGN.md approved purpose; current PROJECT_STATUS.md resume API/history/onboarding implementation; owner current consolidation brief. Public catalog lookup returned no applicable purposeContract.
contract.canonicalPurpose: RolePatch tailors a resume and supporting application material to the evidence and language of a specific job.
contract.audience: Job seekers organizing supplied experience and preparing a specific application.
contract.job: Manage every master-resume fact and supporting source in one place, then tailor for a JD; encounter purchase options only when needed.
contract.thesis: Consolidate the nine-link application into Resume Builder and Jobs using approved Precision Studio fonts/colors; compare tabs, outline and document-first editing before selecting.
contract.system: Current Geist and Space Grotesk, graphite actions, neutral surfaces and document typography; existing project-native forms/disclosures and account menu. Landing/footer fixed.
contract.signature: A factual achievement, its source and Always include selection are edited together; roles/projects/education remain one master feeding job-specific versions.
contract.risk: Consolidation can create a long page; each direction offers a different section-discovery/editing model without adding primary destinations.
contract.qualityBar: Two primary signed-in destinations; no top-level Pricing/Tools/Blog/Evidence/Proof/Experience/Settings. All original master, evidence and stash data stays reachable, sources do not imply verification, phone editing usable, price/cost states contextual. Latest owner scope: only Resume Builder and Jobs are primary workspaces; application actions/status and resume History are together under Jobs.
